data_fields.donor_constant: list of (item id, count), one entry per input

data_fields.name: shop_discount_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 + 2 * Discount skill level, capped at 24 (donor uses item id instead of price: defect)

data_fields.name: shop_sell_guard_ratio
data_fields.donor_constant: sell-back value must not exceed 0.5 of the list price (load-time check)

best_idea: A barter is one recipe row (inputs as item id plus count, a zeny price, one result); the server validates every input and the price before it removes anything, then consumes and grants in one pass, and a unique input is taken by its own bag id so the exact piece changes hands.
decision_why: Keeps the validate-everything-then-apply order and the exact-piece rule for unique inputs. Changes the recipe from a script macro into a data row, sums stackable inputs per item before checking, checks every removal result, and clamps the per-unit shop price at zero (the donor shop discount is broken: it uses the item id, not the price).
acceptance: Server test: a recipe needs 3 Iron, 1 Blade (unique) and 500 zeny for one Sword; a player with 5 Iron, 1 Blade and 600 zeny gets the Sword, and 3 Iron, the Blade and 500 zeny are removed in one settle. With 2 Iron the trade is refused and nothing is removed. A recipe naming Iron twice (2 and 2) with 3 Iron in the bag is refused, not granted. Player sees the exact shortfall per input before confirming.
